raw: {"analysis":"Response RGD provides a more comprehensive and structured plan that better addresses the specific constraints of the ticket. It correctly identifies the high-risk nature of the shared utilities affecting three microservices, explicitly handles the known flaky thumbnail check with a skip marker and flake ledger, and sets clear cost-control measures for the expensive 45-minute CI runs. Response PGD is also solid but has some gaps: it doesn't explicitly address the CI cost/time constraint, its handling of the flaky test is less precise (\"non-blocking\" rather than explicitly skipped), and the rollback plan lacks the specific metric thresholds that RGD provides (error rate > 0.1%, cache miss rate > 5%). RGD's gate structure is more rigorous, requiring exact SHA verification and independent review, which better matches the criticality of the change.","verdict":"RGD"}
